Core: Data display

Source: vignettes/core-data-display.Rmd
core-data-display.Rmd
library(shiny)
library(shiny.mantine)

An R rewrite of the “Data display” category on mantine.dev/core.

Accordion

https://mantine.dev/core/accordion/ — a collapsible list of sections; AccordionItem()s (each with AccordionControl() + AccordionPanel()) nest inside Accordion(). Set multiple = TRUE to allow more than one panel open at once.

Accordion(
  inputId = "faq", value = "q1",
  AccordionItem(value = "q1", AccordionControl("What is Mantine?"), AccordionPanel("A React component library.")),
  AccordionItem(value = "q2", AccordionControl("What is Shiny?"), AccordionPanel("An R web framework."))
)

Avatar

https://mantine.dev/core/avatar/ — a user profile picture (or initials/icon fallback); AvatarGroup() overlaps several together.

AvatarGroup(
  Avatar(src = "https://i.pravatar.cc/100?img=1", radius = "xl"),
  Avatar(src = "https://i.pravatar.cc/100?img=2", radius = "xl"),
  Avatar("+3", radius = "xl")
)

BackgroundImage

https://mantine.dev/core/background-image/ — a container with a CSS background image, for placing content over a photo.

BackgroundImage(src = "https://placehold.co/600x300", radius = "md", Center(h = 200, Text("Overlay text", c = "white", fw = 700)))

Badge

https://mantine.dev/core/badge/ — a small colored label/pill, commonly used for statuses/counts.

Group(Badge("New", color = "green"), Badge("Beta", color = "yellow", variant = "outline"), Badge(3, circle = TRUE, color = "red"))

Card

https://mantine.dev/core/card/ — a bordered/shadowed content container; CardSection() marks a full-bleed section (e.g. an image touching the card’s edges) inside it.

Card(
  withBorder = TRUE, radius = "md", w = 300,
  CardSection(Image(src = "https://placehold.co/300x140")),
  Title("Card title", order = 4, mt = "sm"),
  Text("Card description text.", size = "sm", c = "dimmed")
)

ColorSwatch

https://mantine.dev/core/color-swatch/ — a small color sample square.

Group(ColorSwatch(color = "#228be6"), ColorSwatch(color = "#40c057"), ColorSwatch(color = "#fa5252"))

DataList

https://mantine.dev/core/data-list/ — a key/value list (definition-list style), composed of DataListItem()/ DataListItemLabel()/DataListItemValue().

DataList(
  DataListItem(DataListItemLabel("Name"), DataListItemValue("Ada Lovelace")),
  DataListItem(DataListItemLabel("Role"), DataListItemValue("Engineer"))
)

Image

https://mantine.dev/core/image/ — a styled <img> with a fallbackSrc option and Mantine’s radius/fit props.

Image(src = "https://placehold.co/400x200", radius = "md", fit = "cover", alt = "Placeholder")

Indicator

https://mantine.dev/core/indicator/ — a small badge/dot positioned over an element (e.g. an unread-notifications count on a bell icon).

Indicator(label = "3", size = 16, ActionIcon(inputId = "bell_btn", variant = "light", IconBell(size = 18)))

Kbd

https://mantine.dev/core/kbd/ — renders text styled like a keyboard key, e.g. for documenting shortcuts.

Text("Press ", Kbd("Ctrl"), " + ", Kbd("K"), " to open the command palette.")

NumberFormatter

https://mantine.dev/core/number-formatter/ — formats a numeric value as display text (thousand separators, decimals, prefix/suffix) without being an input.

NumberFormatter(value = 1234567.891, thousandSeparator = TRUE, decimalScale = 2, prefix = "$")

RollingNumber

https://mantine.dev/core/rolling-number/ — an animated rolling/odometer-style number display, e.g. for a live counter.

RollingNumber(value = 1024)

Spoiler

https://mantine.dev/core/spoiler/ — truncates long content behind a “show more” toggle.

Spoiler(maxHeight = 60, showLabel = "Show more", hideLabel = "Hide", Text(paste(rep("Long paragraph text. ", 20), collapse = "")))

ThemeIcon

https://mantine.dev/core/theme-icon/ — a colored, sized container for an icon, matching the rest of the theme (used e.g. as a leading icon next to a title).

Group(ThemeIcon(IconLayoutDashboard(size = 18), color = "blue", variant = "light", size = 36, radius = "md"), Title("Dashboard", order = 3))

Timeline

https://mantine.dev/core/timeline/ — a vertical sequence of events, each a TimelineItem().

Timeline(active = 1, bulletSize = 24, lineWidth = 2,
  TimelineItem(title = "Order placed", "2 days ago"),
  TimelineItem(title = "Order shipped", "1 day ago"),
  TimelineItem(title = "Out for delivery", "Today")
)

Table (with DataTable — a shiny.mantine extra)

https://mantine.dev/core/table/ — Table() and its sub-parts (TableThead()/TableTbody()/TableTr()/TableTh()/TableTd()/…) compose a table by hand, exactly matching plain HTML <table> structure, for full control:

Table(
  TableThead(TableTr(TableTh("Name"), TableTh("Role"))),
  TableTbody(
    TableTr(TableTd("Ada"), TableTd("Engineer")),
    TableTr(TableTd("Grace"), TableTd("Researcher"))
  )
)

DataTable() is not a mantine.dev component — a shiny.mantine extra built on top of Table() with search/sort/selection already wired up, reporting the currently visible/selected row values to Shiny:

DataTable(
  "team",
  data = list(list(value = 1, name = "Ada", role = "Engineer"), list(value = 2, name = "Grace", role = "Researcher")),
  columns = list(list(key = "name", label = "Name"), list(key = "role", label = "Role")),
  searchable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE, selectable = TRUE
)

OverflowList (not wrapped)

https://mantine.dev/core/overflow-list/ needs a renderItem/ renderOverflow render-prop function to customize how overflowing items collapse into a “+N” indicator — a poor fit for R’s data-only props. Not covered.
